observations.operation: initialize command result D6 to RETURN_FAIL (20) and IoErr D7 to ERROR_INVALID_RESIDENT_LIBRARY (122)
when ReadArgs fails, fetch IoErr into D7 and leave D6 at RETURN_FAIL
store the low 16 bits of SIZE/N in TextAttr.ta_YSize, then reject when that word is <= 4 (CMP.W/BLS); set IoErr 115 and leave D6 at RETURN_FAIL
use IoErr 205 for OpenDiskFont failure and for a missing console task; a proportional font without PROP instead closes the font and sets IoErr 212
a NULL console Window takes the success path and clears both result and IoErr
PutStr/Flush results are not tested; after output the command sets result and IoErr to zero
return D6 as the command result after publishing D7 through SetIoErr

conclusion: ReadArgs and SIZE failures return RETURN_FAIL with the applicable IoErr; the no-window console path and completed output path return success. Output failures do not change the final success result.
evidence_limits: This audit records static control flow; exact guest IoErr side effects of failing DOS output calls need Workbench execution.
This audit does not establish original guest diagnostics, PURE/resident lifecycle, licensing, package admission or shipping equivalence.
